seed_ledger.name: Kingsboro NetZero Data Center power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: behind-the-meter gas near a transmission line only; no pipe, lateral or length named. The developer withdrew its land offer in mid-2026 and the county passed a two-year data center moratorium, so the project looks dead. Reported campus is 900 MW (1800 MW unverified). Searches run: 7. Sources: EIA workbook (no matching project); FERC and Federal Register (no filing naming the plant or developer); NC Utilities Commission (nothing found); state air permit (none found); county records and local news (Sound Rivers, WFAE, Public Radio East, Rocky Mount Telegram: gas availability doubted, no pipe named, land offer withdrawn, moratorium); developer and trade press (Data Center Knowledge, Bisnow, Data Center Dynamics, Baxtel: proximity to a gas transmission line only).

evidence.note: developer plans gas-powered campus, no pipe named

seed_ledger.name: Valara Holdings High Performance Compute Center power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: ONSITE_NO_PIPE: the former Kohler plant is on-site with 45 gas generators and 11 turbines (457 MW permitted by the state air regulator Sept 2026); plant is private and islanded. A secondary Substack post citing the Post and Courier says the site has a direct gas connection and NorthMark was working with Transco and the City of Union gas system, but no new lateral, length or tap is sourced and the Post and Courier page could not be fetched. State air application only says pipeline natural gas is used. Searches run: 8. Sources: SC air permit application (pipeline natural gas, no supplier named); SC PSC ruling coverage (no gas supply detail); FERC and Federal Register (no Transco filing for Valara); local news (Live5, Fox Carolina, WSPA: permits and lawsuit only); Post and Courier (blocked); SC PSC docket not opened.
